learnings: Created FavoritesProvider.cs in MtgDeckInfoScraper.App/LocalStorage/ mirroring CurrentScrapeProvider pattern; uses ILocalStorageAccessor with key 'Favorites' and stores List<DeckInfo>.
Public API: GetFavoritesAsync() → List<DeckInfo> (null-coalesced to empty list), AddFavoriteAsync(DeckInfo) with Id-based dedup, RemoveFavoriteAsync(Guid), IsFavoriteAsync(Guid) → bool.
Registered FavoritesProvider as Scoped in MauiProgram.RegisterLocalStorageAccess alongside CurrentScrapeProvider.
